openingRequest.zh-CN: 请帮助我们设计一个企业内部知识代理，让员工问到带引用、且经过权限校验的内部业务答案。
openingRequest.en-US: Please help us design an enterprise knowledge agent so employees can get internal business answers that carry citations and pass permission checks.

visibleContext.zh-CN: 我们是一家跨区域运营的公司，内部知识散落在文档索引、wiki 和工单里。管理层希望员工能向代理提问并得到带引用的业务答案，而检索必须先过权限，不能把无权内容讲出去。
visibleContext.en-US: We are a company operating across regions. Internal knowledge is scattered across a document index, wiki, and tickets. Leadership wants employees to ask an agent and get cited business answers, and retrieval must pass permissions so entitled-only content is not spoken aloud.

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 员工无权阅读的内容不得被引用；对外口径必须先经人工确认（HITL）
visibleConstraints.en-US: Content the employee is not entitled to must not be quoted; anything that becomes external customer-facing copy needs a human (HITL)

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 内部文档与工单不得发送到境外的第三方大模型
visibleConstraints.en-US: Internal documents and tickets must not be sent to offshore third-party LLMs
The agent must not fabricate citations

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 允许调用的工具是文档索引、ACL 目录和 wiki/工单检索；代理不得在检索时绕过 ACL
visibleConstraints.en-US: Allowed tools are the document index, ACL directory, and wiki/ticket lookup; the agent must not retrieve while ignoring ACL

deliverables.zh-CN: 企业知识代理方案设计文档
带权限检索与无引用问答的权衡分析
deliverables.en-US: Permissioned retrieval vs. uncited Q&A trade-off analysis

deliverables.zh-CN: 无权内容拦截与对外口径人工确认（HITL）流程
deliverables.en-US: Unauthorized-content block and external-copy human-in-the-loop (HITL) process

deliverables.zh-CN: 引用质量、权限命中与一线采用的度量体系
deliverables.en-US: Citation quality, permission-hit, and frontline-adoption measurement framework

learnerRules.zh-CN: 你只有12个问题预算来了解这家客户的知识代理现状
learnerRules.en-US: You have a budget of 12 questions to understand this customer's knowledge-agent situation

learnerRules.zh-CN: 每个问题必须指定由哪位干系人回答
learnerRules.en-US: Each question must specify which stakeholder will answer

learnerRules.zh-CN: 你需要在DISCOVERY阶段逐步发现隐藏的业务事实
learnerRules.en-US: You need to gradually discover hidden business facts in the DISCOVERY phase

learnerRules.zh-CN: 在PITCH阶段你需要向管理层展示方案并争取批准
learnerRules.en-US: In the PITCH phase, you must present the solution to management for approval
